title: Attach a parachute and a rail button to named anchors, render, describe
prompt: The working directory holds a RocketWright rocket project with a streamer and no parachute. The RocketWright CLI (`rw`) is on your PATH and its skill doc is at {skill_doc}. Add a parachute and a rail button, attaching each to a named anchor. Then render the `profile` and `iso` views and describe what each view shows.

predicates.desc: a parachute attached to a named anchor
a rail button attached to a named anchor
the final design check is clean
the answer describes the profile view
the answer describes the iso view
